source.place: Tag 0D62, proof split into existence and uniqueness

proof.text: Fix a compatible c:E→K and a cohomological degree m. Reduce IsIso c to IsIso H^m(c) by DerivedCategory.isIso_iff, and use the stalkwise sheaf isomorphism criterion on the underlying abelian sheaves; SheafOfModules.toSheaf reflects isomorphisms. Fix a point x and take b,B from hlocal. The stabilization lemma supplies N with -N<=m and eventual successor isomorphisms for open cohomology in degrees m-1 and m.

Regard the truncation sequence as Functor.ofOpSequence. For each U in B, apply the eventually-isomorphic-tower theorem to its degree m-1 open cohomology tower to get R^1 lim=0. Induction on n>=N, using functoriality, shows the maps to level N are composites of successor isomorphisms in degree m; they are therefore injective. Apply derivedLimit_stalk_injective to the specified Roos triangle to get injectivity of H^m(π followed by the Nth projection) at x.

Compatibility identifies the composite of H^m(c)_x with the injective stalk projection with the stalk of the truncation map at -N. As -N<=m, the latter is an isomorphism. Its bijectivity gives injectivity of H^m(c)_x; lift the image of an arbitrary target stalk element through the bijective composite and cancel the injective projection to get surjectivity. All stalk maps of H^m(c) are thus bijective. Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_iff_stalkFunctor_map_iso and reflection by SheafOfModules.toSheaf give IsIso H^m(c), and DerivedCategory.isIso_iff gives IsIso c.

title: Uniqueness and isomorphism in the pointwise truncation limit argument
statement: The hypotheses and data of lem-pc-ringed-space-pointwise-truncation-limit imply that every compatible morphism c : E ⟶ K is an isomorphism.
